reviews.text: 10/10 experience! Javi is so professional and knowledgeable. His team demoed, tiled and plastered all in one week. He went above and beyond to fix the little things and our pool has never looked or circulated better! Excited to move forward with Innovative as our weekly pool service company.

Javi did an amazing job replacing my old broken pool pump and pool filter.  He is very thorough with his repair work and got everything updated and running perfectly for us.  I’ve worked with other pool companies and Innovative Pooltech has been the best!

Javier from Innovative Pool Tech has been providing exceptional service to our Villas of Buckingham Fountain for the past two years. His technical expertise is top-notch, and he consistently delivers reliable and affordable pool maintenance. We truly appreciate his dedication and professionalism. Wishing him continued success!

I can not belive the miracle Javier performed on our residential swimming pool! Very professional, very detail oriented, very efficient. He always told us what was happening, what he was doing and what was coming next. No surprises. I am seriously grateful for Javier taking on this challenge and succeeding! He gave us our pool back!!

Javier has been doing my pool maintenance and all repair work since last 2 years

He is very professional, skilled and punctual.

Highly recommend him

Alaniz pool services did an exceptional job at restoring my pool. Alaniz Pool team was very thorough with the inspection of my pool equipment and the service provided.  As my pool was being restored the  communication was always very timely.  Through this process all of my concerns were addressed right away.  I will continue to use Alaniz Pool services and highly recommended them.

They’re attentive to detail, do what they say they’ll do, and actually test water parameters. The rates are fair and my pool has never looked better. My last pool company allowed algae to take over and Alaniz Pools got us back to crystal clear in a day.

Javi came on very short notice to look at our pool.  We ended up needed a new motor and he thoroughly explained options and pros/coms with various models.  He came back asap to replace it and walked through all the new settings and answered all of our questions.  Very professional and reasonably priced.  Highly recommend!

We are very satisfied with the fantastic job that Innovative Pool Tech did for us! Our Pool and Spa are sparkling clean.  The two gentlemen were very astute and professional.  It was basically a new pool equipment installation.  Clean and efficient setup.  I'm glad we chose Innovative Pool Tech.  If you want the best don't settle for less!
They replaced my pool pump in a very timely manner and the price was fair. The pump works great and now I use their weekly pool cleaning. My pool has never been this healthy! ❤️

Javi / Innovative just replaced our old pool pump with a new, larger, more efficient model.  Work was done quickly, efficiently and at a competitive cost.  If you need pool service or repair, you should definitely consider Innovative Pool Tech!

We have had zero issues since we started working with Innovative Pool Tech.

Our pool has never looked so good and they are always on time rain or shine.

Had a small leak due to the freezing weather we had last week… called On Friday and it’s fixed on Monday.

Thank you very much Taking care of us!!!

I just had Innovative PoolTech/Alaniz Pools clean my pool and replace my filter cartridges. Javi (the owner) came with his pool guy because it’s the first time I’ve used this company I’m guessing. They both were soo friendly and my pool looks amazing!!! Javi went above and beyond to make me happy. I highly recommend this Company for your pool cleaning!! Thanks again.
Chris Vigil/Dallas Tx.

I was referred by a good friend and I had a very great experience working with Alex. He showed up very professional and he was very nice! He diagnosed the issue and fixed it and most importantly at a reasonable price. I highly recommend if you need ANYTHING done with your pool or pool equipment don’t hesitate to call Javier. Moving forward I’ll be using this company. It’s refreshing to know that there still good people out there who don’t try to sell you on things that are not necessary or are s
This pool company knows what they’re doing! I can always count on them to do a great job

I am so glad I found Alaniz Pools LLC to help me with my pool. I really thought my pool had no hope of saving but Javi & his team were able to get my pool working again. They came out and worked on the pool almost everyday to check on it & within a week they were able to get pool water looking amazing again & we were able to enjoy our pool the remainder of the summer. They are very professional, trustworthy & efficient! I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a new pool service.

Javi is the best! Not only was he quick to reply but he showed up on time and was more than willing to answer all my questions (without making me feel like an idiot). I would highly recommend Javi and Alaniz Pools for your pool needs!

We’ve been using Alaniz Pools services for about 2.5 years now and have no plans to change. When we first moved in and became first time pool owners, we worked with another pool service for 2021 winter storm repairs. We obtained Alaniz Pools information from the previous owner and consulted with Javier on the repairs and maintenance costs. The prices are very reasonable for the exceptional service. Javier is very responsive,  professional, patient, and informative. We have not had any issues wit

Our very first year of having a pool, it looked like a lake! Javi did what it took to have a crystal clear pool in no time! We have been using him for about 2 years now and have referred him to other relatives. He is very professional,communicates well and is punctual. His pricing is also reasonable!

We are able to enjoy our pool without worries. They keep it clean and are always willing to answer any questions I might have. Javi and his guy are friendly and professional. I highly recommend their services.
